Product Details and Specifications

Product Description

The Richardson Adjustable Snapback Trucker Cap is the ultimate blend of style, comfort, and durability. Featuring a structured six-panel design, breathable polyester mesh back, and a pre-curved visor, it delivers a perfect fit and all-day wearability. The adjustable snapback ensures versatility, while its cotton-poly blend makes it ideal for embroidery. Whether for business, teams, or personal branding, this custom cap is made to stand out. Customize yours today!

Available Sizes

  • Adult:XL - ONE SIZE

Brand

Richardson is a leading brand in premium headwear, celebrated for its exceptional quality and innovative designs. Offering a wide range of caps and hats, they are crafted for durability and comfort, making them ideal for both performance and casual wear. Richardson’s versatile styles and reliable craftsmanship make them a top choice for customization and branding.

  • All Richardson

Product Details

  • 60/40 cotton/polyester
  • 100% polyester mesh back
  • Structured, six-panel, mid-profile
  • Pre-curved contrast stitched visor
  • Underbill matches the color of visor
  • Adjustable plastic snapback
